name: Han Shou

behavior.core_traits: solid, literal, hard-working, protective of the men who have to execute staff abstractions
behavior.speech_pattern: turns plans into marching intervals, frontage, and who physically relieves whom
behavior.values: clear orders, neighboring support, keeping a line from being asked to do two incompatible jobs
behavior.conflict_style: does not argue politics; objects when a plan gives his formation an impossible physical task
behavior.individual_tell: counts companies under his breath when a plan changes rapidly

narration_rule: Static behavior guidance only; mutable goals, relationships, knowledge, health, authority, and outcomes remain in live state.
